projects.name: AWS · Louisa County
projects.sites: Lake Anna + North Creek technology campuses
projects.phaseAsOf: May 2026 county budget; present operating status not independently verified
projects.boundary: Two campuses share the reviewed financial account. Figures cannot be allocated to an individual building from these records.
projects.taxGap: Campus-specific tax collections and rebates actually paid are not isolated in the reviewed records. Unknown is not $0.

records.title: Future county revenue
records.period: Annual at $11B full buildout; FY2027 budget forecast
records.scope: The county anticipates new annual revenue at full buildout.
records.limit: Not collected tax. The passage does not resolve gross versus net of rebates; do not subtract a rebate percentage from this figure.

records.title: Water & sewer infrastructure
records.period: One-time infrastructure estimate in FY2024 report, issued November 20, 2024
records.recipient: Infrastructure serving both campuses; Louisa County Water Authority to own and maintain it
records.scope: Offsite water and sewer works, not all electricity-grid costs.
records.limit: Estimated project cost, not a receipt or final construction bill. Later reimbursements are acknowledged separately; the two records must not be added.

records.title: Infrastructure reimbursements
records.scope: The FY2025 report identifies AWS infrastructure reimbursements.
records.limit: The cited capital-contribution increase also includes land-sale contributions. It cannot all be assigned to AWS. A project receipt ledger is needed for the exact amount.

records.title: Revenue returned to AWS
records.period: FAQ labels a 20-year term and displays 2026–2046
records.scope: Share of incremental tax revenue, tiered by certified capital investment. This is a rebate payment mechanism, not the fictional game’s assumed tax reduction.
records.limit: No rebate disbursement verified. The stated term and displayed endpoints need reconciliation against the executed agreement; no total rebate dollars calculated.

projects.ask: Please provide annual AWS tax collections by tax type and fund, rebate payments, the executed performance agreement and amendments, and the campus-specific infrastructure reimbursement ledger. Identify ongoing water-system maintenance obligations and the studies estimating health impacts.

projects.name: AWS · New Carlisle
projects.phaseAsOf: July 9, 2026 operator statement; not a building-by-building occupancy audit
projects.boundary: Campus-wide tax and water statements; the road record concerns a shared regional interchange, not infrastructure exclusively for AWS.
projects.taxGap: An annual campus tax-receipt ledger and distribution among local public bodies were not verified. The operator’s 35-year projection is not cash received.

records.title: Future property taxes
records.period: 35-year horizon stated July 9, 2026; annual schedule not supplied
records.recipient: Local public bodies; fund-by-fund distribution not verified
records.scope: AWS projects property-tax revenue over 35 years.
records.limit: Not independently verified collections. Do not annualize it or compare it directly with Louisa’s full-buildout annual forecast.

records.title: Road contribution received
records.recipient: St. Joseph County, for the State Road 2 / Larrison Boulevard interchange
records.scope: County staff said the money was in the county’s possession, awaiting transfer to the state after signed documents.
records.limit: Verified against official minutes, not a bank reconciliation. Receipt by the county does not establish final expenditure by INDOT or the entire project cost.

records.title: County’s part of the road package
records.payer: St. Joseph County funding and in-kind contributions
records.recipient: Shared State Road 2 / Larrison Boulevard interchange
records.scope: Includes prior expenses, donated right-of-way and acquisitions. Together with AWS’s $7M, this describes a $19M local package.
records.limit: Not a $12M new household-tax bill, not all cash, and not the interchange’s total cost. The road serves multiple users; do not assign the county share entirely to AWS.

records.title: Water & sewer investment
records.period: July 9, 2026 statement; payment schedule not supplied
records.recipient: Water and sewer infrastructure serving the development area
records.limit: The paid-to-date amount and allocation by recipient were not independently verified. Do not label it a received payment or add it to public tax revenue.

projects.ask: Please provide annual campus property-tax receipts and their distribution, the $7M road-contribution receipt and subsequent transfers, the cash/in-kind breakdown of the county’s $12M obligation, and paid invoices for the stated $114M water/sewer investment. Provide enforceable utility cost-allocation terms and project-specific health-impact studies.

healthGaps: Attributable illness and mortality, including asthma-related outcomes
Medical spending, lost work/school time and economic valuation of health risks
Where exposed people live, including communities near supplying power plants
Compensation paid to affected people and who bears remaining costs
comparisonRules: Receipt, commitment, estimate and projection are different evidence states. Verification of a statement is not verification of payment.
A county financial report is useful evidence, but not every management estimate in it is an audited transaction.
Do not subtract taxes from health damages or produce a net-benefit ranking. Population, geography, timing and valuation differ.
Health-cost estimates for these campuses were not identified in this bounded review. This does not establish that no study exists or that no harm occurs.
No common ten-year horizon, per-household bill or annualized total is invented. Investment is not tax revenue, and assessed property value is not tax collected.
The original simulator remains fictional and cannot alter these sourced records.
